actions.name: R3-1 Syntax Template Literals
actions.description: Tests whether template literals parse. Writes syn-template.json on success.

actions.name: R3-2 Syntax Destructuring
actions.description: Tests destructuring without default values. Writes syn-destructure.json on success.

actions.name: R3-3 Syntax Spread
actions.description: Tests array and object spread. Writes syn-spread.json on success.

actions.name: R3-4 Static Built-in Access
actions.description: Tests which Object and Array static helpers work, writing after every check so a silent halt is visible.

actions.name: R3-5 Assigning To An Injected Global
actions.description: Tests whether assigning to _settings halts the script silently. Read-only otherwise.

actions.name: R3-6 Permission Denial
actions.description: Touches capabilities this action was NOT granted, writing after every attempt so a silent halt is visible.

actions.name: R3-7 Object Shapes
actions.description: Dumps the shape of _vars, tracks, playlists and custom tags. Read-only. Select the sandbox tracks first.
